description: This file defines an enumeration 'ConditionClinicalStatus' representing various statuses of clinical conditions within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes statuses like ACTIVE, INACTIVE, HISTORY_OF, RECURRENCE, RELAPSE, REMISSION, and RESOLVED, with documentation for each.

classes.name: ConditionClinicalStatus
classes.description: An enum representing different clinical status conditions for health conditions in OpenMRS.
